title: Glowing magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x="55" y="62" width="14" height="30" rx="6" fill="#8B4513" transform="rotate(-45 62 77)"/>
  <!-- Handle highlight -->
  <rect x="57" y="64" width="4" height="24" rx="2" fill="#CD853F" transform="rotate(-45 59 76)"/>
  <!-- Glass lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="42" r="26" fill="none" stroke="#B8860B" stroke-width="7"/>
  <!-- Lens ring highlight -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="42" r="26" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 6" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Glass lens interior (translucent glow) -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="42" r="21" fill="#7EC8E3" opacity="0.45"/>
  <!-- Glow inside lens -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="42" r="16" fill="#AEE6FF" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="38" r="10" fill="#E0F7FF" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Lens shine -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="34" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.4" transform="rotate(-30 34 34)"/>
  <!-- Sparkle rays -->
  <g stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="42" y1="6" x2="42" y2="12"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="72" x2="42" y2="78"/>
    <line x1="6" y1="42" x2="12" y2="42"/>
    <line x1="72" y1="42" x2="78" y2="42"/>
    <line x1="17" y1="17" x2="21" y2="21"/>
    <line x1="63" y1="63" x2="67" y2="67"/>
    <line x1="17" y1="67" x2="21" y2="63"/>
    <line x1="63" y1="21" x2="67" y2="17"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <circle cx="70" cy="14" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="14" cy="70" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="85" cy="50" r="1" opacity="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="85" r="1" opacity="0.8"/>
  </g>
</svg>
